queries.prompt: Run Athena SQL queries on VPC Flow Logs and WAF logs exported to Apache Iceberg tables in `s3tablescatalog/aws-cloudwatch`.
Enable CloudWatch Logs S3 Tables integration (`observabilityadmin create-s3-table-integration`) with KMS encryption and Lake Formation permissions.
Correlate VPC Flow Logs (`amazon_vpc__flow`) with S3 object journal tables in Athena using CloudWatch S3 Tables.
Fix `CATALOG_NOT_FOUND` on `s3tablescatalog/aws-cloudwatch` and inspect schemas with `glue get-tables` before writing SQL.
Query `amazon_eks__audit` and `amazon_route53resolver__query` system tables with SQL in Athena.
Discover application CloudWatch Log Groups and debug stack traces for a failing payment API.
Create a multi-region AWS CloudTrail trail with S3 storage.
Set up an encrypted SNS topic for CloudWatch alarm email notifications.
Write PromQL queries against Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus.
Add Amazon Cognito PKCE login to a React web app.
Configure AWS Direct Connect BGP peering and SiteLink.
Run an AWS Well-Architected Framework scorecard review.
